objective: Prove, for every law that composes like cycles: (1) on each knot range the parallelogram relation of any knot through it is the graph of the Mal'tsev operation induced by A's polymorphism on the top, which is x - y + z for an elementary abelian p-group on the top, every polymorphism acts on the top by affine maps, and every top image on knot-range variables is a coset of a subgroup; (2) every three-variable circuit is, modulo the tops, the addition table of an elementary abelian p-group up to relabelling; (3) every system's matroid is a direct sum of matroids each representable over a finite field (the weak form of Conjecture 5 of MATROID-CONVERSE-20261021-001B-P001), and every such direct sum occurs.
status: Proved by AFFINE-TOPS-20261021-001B-P001 (V1 prose proof with randomized checks; AFFINE-TOPS-20261021-001A-P001, the overlap proof's Theorem 2, the Galois connection, Wedderburn, the density theorem and Rado's theorem cited). In a law that composes like cycles, every knot's parallelogram relation is the graph of the Mal'tsev operation induced on its range's top, which is therefore unique and pp-definable; every polymorphism commutes with it; it is x - y + z for an elementary abelian p-group, polymorphisms act affinely, and every top image on knot-range variables is a coset. Three-variable circuits are, modulo the tops, addition tables of elementary abelian p-groups. Every system's matroid is a direct sum of rank-one parallel classes and matroids representable over finite fields (the endomorphism fields of the tops as modules over the linear parts), which proves the weak form of Conjecture 5 of MATROID-CONVERSE-20261021-001B-P001; every such direct sum occurs.
title: Proof: affine tops and representable matroids
